# `workspace` operations

5 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all references](index.md).

### workspace.list

Read workspaces. read-only, idempotent.

List saved project and device contexts.

No arguments.

```sh
tomaccoctl call workspace.list
```

### workspace.save

Save workspace. writes, idempotent.

Save a named project, target and optional native test scenario without modifying project sources.

- `name` string, required (matching `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}`)
- `path` string, required
- `platform` string (one of android, ios, web, linux; default "android")
- `device` string (default "")
- `bundle_id` string (default "")
- `scenario` string (default "")

```sh
tomaccoctl call workspace.save '{"name":"<name>","path":"<path>"}'
```

### workspace.remove

Remove workspace. **destructive, ask first**, idempotent.

Remove a saved context; project files remain intact.

- `name` string, required

```sh
tomaccoctl call workspace.remove '{"name":"<name>"}'
```

### workspace.context

Load agent context. read-only, idempotent.

Read project capabilities, tools, devices, recent jobs and executable recipes in one call.

- `name` string, required

```sh
tomaccoctl call workspace.context '{"name":"<name>"}'
```

### workspace.execute

Run workspace. writes.

Build, test, lint, run or execute the saved UI scenario using the shared native APIs.

- `name` string, required
- `action` string, required (one of build, test, lint, run, ui_test)
- `configuration` string (one of debug, release; default "debug")

```sh
tomaccoctl call workspace.execute '{"name":"<name>","action":"build"}'
```
